steps.title: Farther, but not the cause
steps.say: Yes — in early July, during northern summer, Earth is actually farthest from the Sun. But that is not why it is hot.

ops.text:
Yes — Earth is farthest
in early July.

steps.title: Distance is tiny
steps.say: The distance change only alters sunlight by about seven percent. That is much too small to make summer.

steps.title: Tilt makes direct rays
steps.say: What really matters is the tilt: it makes summer sunlight hit the northern hemisphere more directly, and days are longer.

ops.text:
Tilt → more direct rays
+ longer days.
